title: Processes
description: Reusable procedures: API calls, loops, decisions, approvals, checks and browser steps. Every save creates a new version.

empty.title: No processes yet
empty.text: Start from a template – user onboarding, access reviews, attribute optimisation, health checks – or build your own.
empty.askForAccess: Ask a designer or administrator to create processes or to give you access.

card.archiveConfirm: Archive "{{name}}"? Its schedules are disabled; runs and versions are kept.
card.restrictedHint: Access restricted by an access list

templates.title: Start from a template
templates.noMatch: No template matches. Clear the search or the filters.
templates.haveKind: You have a platform of this kind
templates.missingKind: No platform of this kind yet – add one under Platforms
templates.nextText: Try it with a dry run – it simulates every change and writes the full protocol – then let it run on a schedule.
templates.missingPlatform: The process needs a {{kind}} platform. Add one under Platforms before the first run.

bundles.title: Set up together
bundles.hint: Bundles: processes, a dashboard and their schedules (and optional monitors) that belong together, set up in one go on your platform.
bundles.scheduleOff: schedule {{cron}} (off until you turn it on)
bundles.monitor: Monitor “{{name}}” (off until you turn it on)
bundles.platformHint: A platform of kind {{kinds}} that you may use
bundles.noPlatform: You have no platform for “{{label}}” yet ({{kinds}}).
bundles.existingHint: Processes and dashboards set up before are kept or brought to the template’s version (a new process version). Schedules and monitors that exist are always kept – they hold your settings.
bundles.withDryRuns: Start one dry run per process
bundles.withDryRunsHint: A dry run simulates every change and writes the full protocol – nothing on the platform changes.
bundles.offHint: Schedules and monitors are created switched off. After the setup you turn them on in one step.
bundles.resultText: Everything below is ready. Check the dry runs, then turn the schedules on.
bundles.resultFailed_one: {{count}} item could not be set up – see below.
bundles.resultFailed_other: {{count}} items could not be set up – see below.
bundles.turnOnText: {{schedules}} schedule(s) and {{monitors}} monitor(s) were created switched off. Turn them on once the dry runs look right.

import.title: Import process (YAML or JSON)
import.hint: Paste a definition or load one file to review it first. Selecting several files imports each of them directly (e.g. the files in the repository's examples/processes folder).

bundle.hint: A package (JSON, created with "Export all processes & dashboards") contains several processes and dashboards. Credentials and platforms are never part of a package.
bundle.conflict: When an item with the same id already exists
bundle.label: Packages: several processes and dashboards in one file

manualTemplate.name: New manual procedure
manualTemplate.description: A procedure of manual steps: people carry out each step, tick its checklist, enter its fields and add evidence. Steps marked so are verified by a second person.
manualTemplate.instructions: Describe what to do in this step (Markdown).
manualTemplate.prepareItem1: Announce the work to the people affected
manualTemplate.prepareItem2: Have the tools and spare parts at hand

newManualProcedureHint: Checklists and evidence, done by people – no platform needed

create.title: New process
create.name: Name
create.idHint: Used in addresses, schedules and the API. It cannot be changed later.
create.idInvalid: Use lower-case letters, digits and dashes (at most 48), starting and ending with a letter or digit.

startHint.blank: A start step only. You add the steps in the editor.
startHint.manual: Three manual steps with checklists, ready to fill in.
startHint.template: A copy of a template. Its connections are bound when you run it.
